to the Minister of National Health and Welfare (Mr. Beatty) to tell him so. I understand some Canadians' prudish attitudes, but we have a crisis on our hands. AIDS causes pernicious pneumonia, cancer, wasting syndrome, brain lesions, seizures, spasms and death. We are long overdue for a national strategy to help prevent the spread of AIDS and to treat people living with AIDS with dignity. Vancouver's Needle Exchange Program is exemplary. I urge the federal Government to begin to provide funding for that program. This is not just a municipal issue or a Vancouver issue, this is a national and international tragedy and it is about time that the Minister of National Health and Welfare got off his butt and responded to the situation.
